title: 15# Musa & Bani Israel 3
arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ ثوبي يا حجر، ثوبي يا حجر فَرَأَوْهُ أَحْسَنَ ما خَلَقَ اللَّهُ

وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِى وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ أَنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ ۖ يا ربِّ أرسَلْتَني إلى عبدٍ لا يُريدُ الموتَ

ولولا كرامتُه عليك لشققتُ عليه فالآنَ اَذِن Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

فَاذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَاتِلَا إِنَّا هَاهُنَا قَاعِدُونَ۝

أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا اُدْخُلُوا عَلَيْهِمُ الْبَابَ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّكُمْ غَالِبُونَ ۚ فلمَّا جاءَهُ صَكَّهُ ففقأَ فرجعَ إلى ربِّهِ فقالَ أرسَلتني إلى عبدٍ لا يريدُ الموتَ

فردَّ اللَّهُ إليْهِ عينَهُ قالَ ارجِع فقل لَهُ يضعُ يدَهُ على متنِ ثورٍ فلَهُ بِكلِّ ما غطَّت يدُهُ بِكلِّ شعرةٍ سنةٌ قالَ أي ربِّ ثمَّ مَه قالَ الموتُ

قالَ فالآنَ فسألَ اللَّهَ أن يدنيَهُ منَ الأرضِ المقدَّسةِ رميةً بحجرٍ قالَ رسولُ اللَّهِ صلَّى اللَّهُ عليْهِ وسلَّمَ فلو كنتُ ثَمَّ لأريتُكم قبرَهُ إلى جانبِ الطَّريقِ تحتَ الْكثيبِ الأحمرِ

مررتُ بموسَى فاذا هو قائمٌ يُصلِّي في قبرِه وَإِذْ قَالَ لِفَتَاهُ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَاهُ لَا أَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِيَ حُقُبًا۝

السربة Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَىٰهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا نَصَبًا۝

قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَا إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ الْحُوتَ وَمَا أَنسَانِيهُ إِلَّا الشَّيْطَانُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ ۚ

قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ ۚ فَٱرْتَدَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا۝

أَنَّى بأرضِكَ السَّلامُ Musaعليه السلام told Al-Khadr(الخضر); أَتَّبِعُكَ وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ خُبْرًا۝

قَالَ فَإِنِ اتَّبَعْتَنِي فَلَا تَسْأَلْنِي عَن شَيْءٍ حَتَّىٰ أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا۝

فحملوهما بغير نَوْلٍ Musaعليه السلام said; فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِى ٱلسَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا ۖ قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًٔا إِمْرًا۝

قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا۝

وَكانَتِ الأُولَى مِن مُوسَى نِسْيانًا قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِى بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِى مِنْ أَمْرِى عُسْرًا۝

فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَامًا فَقَتَلَهُ قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةً بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ لَّقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا نُّكْرًا۝

قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا۝

قَالَ إِن سَأَلْتُكَ عَن شَىْءٍ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَٰحِبْنِى ۖ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; قَالَ إِن سَأَلْتُكَ عَن شَىْءٍ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَٰحِبْنِى ۖ قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِن لَّدُنِّى عُذْرًا۝

فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَتَيَا أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ اسْتَطْعَمَا أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا قَالَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا۝

قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنِكَ ۚ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا۝

أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَٰكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٌ يَأْخُذذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًا۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَأَمَّا ٱلْغُلَٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَٰنًا وَكُفْرًا۝

يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَٰنًا وَكُفْرًا۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَأَمَّا الْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَامَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُ كَنزٌ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَالِحًا

يابنئى انى لاستكثر من الاعمال الصالحة حتى يحفظك الله احفظ الله يحفظك وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَالِحًا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبْلُغَا أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ

وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُ عَنْ أَمْرِي ۚ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مُوسَى ، لَوَكَانَ صَبَرَ يُقَصَّ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ أَمْرِهِمَا وَكَانَ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَجِيهًا۝

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مُوسَىٰ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا۝

مُخْلَصًا لا تفضلوني على موسى فإن الناس يصعقون يوم القيامة، فأكون أول من يفيق، لا تفضلونا على موسى وَخَرَّصَعِقًا إن هذهِ لقسمةٌ ما يُرادُ بها وجهُ اللهِ

رَحِمَ اللَّهُ مُوسَى قدْ أُوذِيَ بأَكْثَرَ مِن هذا فَصَبَرَ يَا قَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِي وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ ۖ

عُرِضَتْ عليَّ الأُممُ ، فرأيتُ النبيَّ ومَعهُ الرَّهْطُ ، والنبيَّ ومعهُ الرجُلَ والرَّجُلانِ ، والنبيَّ وليسَ مَعهُ أحَدٌ ، ثم عرض لِي سَوادٌ عظيمٌ ،

أُمَّتي هذِه هذِه اُمَّتِ مُوسى فَإِذَا بِسَوَادٌ عَظِيم يَمْلَأُ الأُفُقَ قالو هذا وادي الازرق كأني أنظر إلى موسى وهو هابطاً من الثنية، وله جؤار إلى الله عزوجل بالتلبية
english:
Musa(موسى) was very shy and that is, how the mu'min(مؤمن); the believer should be.

He was always covering up his body.

Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) said; Musa(موسى) is not showing us his body because, he's suffering from some kind of disease.

And they accused him of leprosy, and they accused him of; they said that, syphilis; the expansion of the testicles.

They said; That's why, he's always covering himself up.

Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); they used to bath together.

They would go out in a river or in a pool, and they would all take their clothes, and they would just go in, and bath in front of each other.

Musa(موسى) would go alone, and would bath alone, and would not let anyone see him.

So, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى wanted Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) to see that, this is not true.

So, Musa(موسى) went to bath.

So, he put his clothes on a rock; on a stone.

And then when he look back; he didn't find the stone, the stone was running away with his clothes.

So, Musa(موسى) is running after the stone, and this in Bukhari(بخاريْ); we'll read the Hadith.

So Musa(موسى) is running after the stone, and he's saying; Bring me my clothes back, stone! Bring me my clothes back!

And he's running after the stone.

And the stone took him around Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) so, they could take a look at Musa(موسى); without any clothes.

They saw the best creation of Allah.

And then, when the issue was done, the stone stopped, by the order of Allah.

So Musa(موسى) had a stick which he would carry with him always, and he started beating the rock; beating the stone.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; And he left on it marks, that could be seen.

He hit it so hard that it left behind marks.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Oh you, who Believe! Be not; like those who annoyed Musa(موسى), but Allah cleared him of that which they alleged, and he was honorable before Allah.

Syedina Musaعليه السلام was with the children of Israel(اسرائيل) in the wilderness.

They got lost in the desert.

And Syedina Musaعليه السلام had to spend his life and his efforts dealing with his people.

And Musa(موسى) wanted good for them.

Nevertheless, they were causing him difficulties, and they were being stubborn and difficult to deal with.

So Musaعليه السلام told his people; Oh my people! Why do you harm me?

When you know that, I am a messenger sent by Allah to you; why do you harm me?

But Musa(موسى) had to endure all of this difficulty with his people.

And then, his brother; Haroon عليه السلام; the prophet of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; the right hand of Musa(موسى); his advisor; wazeer(وزير); his supporter; his helper throughout this period;

His brother Haroon عليه السلام passed away.

Now, Musaعليه السلام is alone to deal with his nation.

With this huge nation of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); Musa(موسى) was alone.

He lost his close associates, and brother, and advisor; Haroon عليه السلام.

And then Musa(موسى) received a visit from the Angel of Death in the form of a man, and this Hadith(حديث) is in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

The Angel of Death presented himself to Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى); in the form of a human being; a man.

And he came, and he told Musaعليه السلام; Are you ready to die?

Because we know that, the Angel of Death takes our lives without announcement.

But he does not take the life of a Nabi(نَبِي) until, they take permission, and they let them know.

The Angel of Death told Musa(موسى); Are you ready to die?

Musaعليه السلام slapped the angel of death in his face, and he knocked his eye out.

He slapped him in his face, and he knocked his eye out.

So, the Angel of Death went to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and said; Oh Allah! You have sent me to a man who doesn't wanna die.

And then the Angel of Death says in another Hadith(حديث); this is not in Bukhari(بخاريْ), I think this Hadith(حديث) was narrated by Imam Ahmad(اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ).

He says; And if it is not because, I know that Musa(موسى) is love to you, I would have made his death difficult.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told the Angel of Death; Go back to Musa(موسی) and tell him to put his hand on the back of an ox and tell him that, every hair that is under his hand; I will give him one year in his life; for every hair under his hand.

The Angel of Death went to Musa(موسى) and said; Oh Musa(موسى)! Allah is telling you put your hand on the back of an ox, and Allah will give you for every hair under your hand; one year to live.

Musa(موسى) by now had chance to think about it.

So, he asked the Angel of Death and then what, and then What will happen?

Then the Angel of Death said; Then you will die.

Musa(موسى) said; Then let me die now.

If in the end; I'm gonna die; let me die now.

We don't know exactly, why Musa(موسى) rejected the angel of death in the beginning?

But Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) says; Maybe it was because Musa(موسى) had a desire in his heart that wasn't fulfilled yet.

And Musa(موسى) wanted that desire; wanted that hope and aspiration to be fulfilled.

And that desire, is a desire that Musa(موسى) has been living for, and awaiting for a long time in his life.

And that is the promise of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to enter into the Holy Land; Jerusalem.

So Musa(موسى) wanted to have the honour of leading his people into the Holy Land and establishing the Islamic nation.

He wanted to have the honour of leading his people into Jerusalem.

But this was the will of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and when Musa(موسى) realized that it wasn't ordained for him.

He said; Then, let me die.

But he said; I have a request.

He told the Angel of death; I have one request.

And that is, that you take me as close as you can, to Jerusalem; take me as close as you can, distance of throwing a stone, and let me die over there.

If I'm not able to enter into Jerusalem alive, at least take me as close as possible to Jerusalem so that, I can die next to it.

I can die next to the walls of Jerusalem.

So Musaعليه السلام was living with the hope that one day, he will enter into the Holy Land.

And the only reason; why he didn't, is because of who?

They were on the Gates of Jerusalem, they were on the gates.

Musa(موسى) told them; Let's go and fight.

They said; Go and fight with your Lord, we're gonna stay right here.

Then two men; Two men; who fear Allahسُبحانه وتعالى whom, Allah has bestowed his blessing; they came to Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) and they told them;

Just walk through the gates and if you do so, you will win, and they refused.

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى did not give Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل), the honour of entering into Jerusalem because they don't deserve it; they're not ready yet.

And because of that, Musa(موسى) was not able to enter into Jerusalem neither was his brother Haroon(هارون).

And Musaعليه السلام died in Al-Tih(تیح); died in the wilderness.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Allah ﷺ has seen the grave of Musa(موسى) and Rasool Ullah says, in the Hadith(حديث) of Al-Isra(اَلْاِسْرى); Rasool Allah ﷺ says that; Indeed, in Al-Isra(اَلْاِسْرى), when Rasool Allah ﷺ travelled to Jerusalem;

he passed next to the grave of Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى), and he saw him praying in his grave to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

We'll move on to a story; an interesting story; an amazing story, that occurred with Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى).

And the reason why I delayed it until now, is because we don't know exactly where the story fits, in terms of the chronological order of events.

And this is the story of Musa(موسى) and Al-Khadr(الخضر).

It is a story of Ajaa'ib(عجائب) of astonishing events from the beginning till the end.

And the way this event happened, is that, Musa(موسى) stood one day on the minbar(منبر); on the pulpit, and was speaking to Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

So, one of the men of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); the children of Israel(اسرائيل) stood up and said; Oh Musa(موسى)! Who is the most knowledgeable man, who's the most knowledgeable person?

So Musa(موسى) said; I am.

Because, he was the Prophet of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; he was the Nabi(نَبِي); he is the one who's receiving revelation from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

According to his knowledge, he is the most knowledgeable person.

Because he is the Nabi(نَبِي); he is the Prophet; he is the one who has a direct link between him and Allah; receiving the Wahi(وحى) from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

So he said; I am.

And this Hadith(حديث) again in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told Musa(موسى); How come you did not say; Allah-u-Aalam(اللَّهُ أَعْلمَ)?

How come you did not say that, Allah knows best, who's the most knowledgeable person?

There is a man, who has knowledge that you do not have.

Musa(موسى) did not say that, I am the most knowledgeable because he is proud or because he's arrogant.

That's not the reason; Musa(موسى) is a Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; he would not do that.

But he said that, he is the most knowledgeable person because that is according to his knowledge.

So when it came to the knowledge of Musa(موسى) that, he is not the most knowledgeable person.

He was so humble that he requested from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to allow him to be a student of that man.

He said; Oh Allah! How can I learn from him?

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told him; You can meet him in the place, where you miss or you lose your fish.

That is where, you will meet this learned man. this wise man, and the name of this man is Al-Khadr(الخضر).

And Rasool Allah ﷺ says in a Hadith(حديث); an authentic Hadith(حديث) that the reason, why he was called the Al-Khadr(الخضر)?

Because Al-Khadr(الخضر); an Arabic means; green.

The reason, why he was named Al-Khadr(الخضر)?

Is because he was one sitting on dry grass, and when he stood up; the grass under him was green.

So that is why, he was given the name Al-Khadr(الخضر); A karamah(الكرامۃ); some Karamat(کرامات) were happening on the hands of Al-Khadr(الخضر).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told Musa(موسى) that you would meet Al-Khadr(الخضر) in this specific place.

So Musa(موسى) took with him his servant, and who was the servant of  Musa(موسى)?

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون).

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون), and we're gonna talk about Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) later.

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) was the servant of Musa(موسى).

And because he was close to Musa(موسى) and learning from Musa(موسى) then, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى appointed him to be the Nabi(نَبِي) of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) when Musa(موسى) passed away.

Because he was close to Musa(موسى) and he was learning from Musa(موسى).

That's how we learn by being close to the learned ones.

So this servant of Musa(موسى) learn the wisdom and the knowledge from Musa(موسى), and then Allahسُبحانه وتعالى appointed him to be the Nabi(نَبِي) after Musa(موسى) and Haroon(هارون) passed away.

So Musa(موسى) went with his servant and it's mentioned in Qur'an; He and his servant; they started embarking on this amazing and wonderful trip.

Some of the prophets had a man or two, following them on the Day of Judgment.

Imagine a Nabi(نَبِي) comes with one or two men with him, that's it.

All of his life; he was making Da'wah(دعوة), and the result was one or two men, that's it.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ said; And I saw some of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) and no one was with them.

There were some Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء); they have no followers whatsoever.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; And then I saw a huge nation.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; I desired; I wished that this would be my ummah(امة).

Rasool Ullah asked the two angels who are with him, Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) and Mikail(ميكائيل).

This is a dream, which Rasool Allah ﷺ was seeing.

Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) came and took his right hand; Mikail(ميكائل) his left hand and they took him in this trip.

So, Rasool Ullah said; Is this my ummah(امة)?

Rasool Ullah wanted this to be his ummah(امة); because this was huge.

They said; No!

These are Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

These are the ummah(امة) of Musa(موسى); Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

But look to the right side!

I look to the right side, and I saw a nation that is filling the horizon.

And then, they told me; Look to the other side!

So, I looked in the other side, and I saw a nation that is filling the horizon.

They said this is your ummah(امة), and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will include with them 70,000 of your ummah(امة) will enter into Jannah(جنة) without going through Hisaab(حساب);

without going through the regular accounting of everyone else.

70,000 of this ummah(امة) will enter into paradise without going through the accountability stage that everyone else has to go through.

This is a Karamah(كرامه) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to this ummah(امة).

But we also learned from the Hadith(حديث) that, the second largest nation is the nation of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); the children of Israel(اسرائيل).

Another Hadith(حديث) narrated by Al-Imam Ahmad(الاِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ); Rasool Allah ﷺ when he went to Hajj(حَجْ); he passed through a valley, he asked; what is the name of this valley?

The name of this valley is the Azraq(ازرق) valley.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Rasool Allah ﷺ says; As if I can see Musa(موسى) coming down from this hill, making Hajj(حَجْ) to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and making Talbiyah(تلبيه).

So, Musaعليه السلام made Hajj(حَجْ); He made Hajj(حَجْ) to the house of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Yunus Ibn matta(يونس ابن مطّه) made Hajj(حَجْ), and another Ahadith(احاديث); we have narrations of other Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) making Hajj(حَجْ) like, Hud(هود) and Saleh(صالح).

So the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; they made Hajj(حَجْ) to the house of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and Allah was making Muhammadﷺ see them, as if it was in front of his eyes.

He saw Musa(موسى), when he was coming down that hill, and he saw Yunus ibn Matta(يونس ابن مطّه) coming down that hill, wearing wool clothes, over a red camel.

These are some of the Fadha'il(فضائل) of Musaعليه السلام.
